## About
Martin's Quality Truck Body is a commercial truck shop in Compton serving truck owners across Los Angeles County. We specialize in custom commercial truck bodies, repairs and fleet maintenance.
Our mechanics and body workers handle aluminum van bodies, service trucks, flatbeds, stake beds and dump bodies. We do custom fabrication, lift gates, electric hoists, PTO's, custom toolboxes, hydraulics, paint and complete body work, and our supplier relationships help us get parts fast.
A reviewer said Oscar, the owner, helped them choose a body style for their truck.

## Services
- Flatbed and graphics from a blank chassis: We take a blank chassis and turn it into a working flatbed, finished with artistic graphics.
- Stake bed and lift gate: We install the stake bed and the lift gate, then finish the body work in your colors.
- Dump bed and hoist: We set up the dump bed and hoist, then complete the design and painting of the body.
- Aluminum van bodies and service trucks: Body work and repair for aluminum van bodies and service trucks, along with flatbeds, stake beds and dump bodies.
- Lift gate installation and repair: We install new lift gates and repair the ones you already run.
- Electric hoists, hydraulics and toolboxes: Electric hoists, PTO's, hydraulics and custom toolboxes installed to fit the way you work.
- Chassis, suspension and springs: When you add a hoist or a flatbed, we customize the chassis, suspension and springs so the truck can handle the equipment and the load you haul.
- Fleet paint and detail: We paint and detail your fleet so your trucks carry your business and logo.
- Oil changes and maintenance: Oil changes, filters, lubrication and other upkeep to limit breakdowns and keep your trucks on the road longer.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of trucks do you work on?
A: We specialize in aluminum trucks, flatbed trucks, stake bed trucks and dump body trucks.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We are in Compton and serve Downey, Long Beach, Torrance and the rest of LA County.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 8:00 AM to 12:30 PM. We are closed Sunday.
